title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction Beyond the Large N Limit via the Twirled Petz Map
abstract: Uses the twirled Petz map to reproduce leading-order entanglement wedge reconstruction formulas and to add subleading 1/N corrections systematically, including an explicit bi-local correction controlled by a subleading Petz kernel.
key_claims: Twirled Petz recovery gives explicit 1/N corrections to entanglement wedge reconstruction
Subleading bi-local correction controlled by a Petz kernel
relevance_note: Abstract only, NOT read. Flagged HYP-033-adjacent (operator recovery) under the scan #20 priority rule, but it is continuum AdS/CFT at large N, not a finite MERA, and says nothing about WHERE recovery fails on a network (the HYP-033 registered statistic). No bearing on the blinded HYP-033 outcome count. Possible use: if HYP-033 ever moves from a decoupling / mutual-information recoverability measure to an explicit recovery map, the twirled Petz map is the default construction and this is a recent reference for it.
